title: legacy-excision + fail-explicit — per-site disposition ledger

buckets.FAIL_EXPLICIT: thrown error or surfaced degraded/isNative/reason flag
buckets.KEEP_BEFITTING: feature-detected progressive-enhancement fallback, retained AND documented as befitting

sites.disposition: Capture is an OPTIMIZATION; the document pointermove/pointerup listeners are the real, unconditional drag path. The swallow is now SURFACED: a new pointerCaptureActive: ComputedRef<boolean> return flips false on failure, dev-warns once, and the catch carries the befitting sentinel.
sites.rationale: Both arms are correct; the document-listener path is the primary. Befitting + now visible.

sites.before: two catch { return false } with no reason
sites.disposition: Each write helper returns a discriminated CopyResult naming the failing channel. UseClipboardOptions gains onCopyError(reason); the composable copy() returns { ok, reason }; CopyFailureReason ('clipboard-api'|'exec-command'|'no-api') + CopyResult ship. The execCommand arm STAYS (legacy-browser fallback — befitting) but is now NAMED + REPORTED. The bare copyToClipboard(text) keeps Promise<boolean> (cross-repo verbatim signature), reporting via onCopyError.
sites.rationale: A copy failure is reported, never a bare unreported false.

sites.disposition: Removed the reactive-defaults synthesis. Config is resolved with the same loud discipline as the sibling colorResolver seam (DEC-AT-2): an explicit config?: BlobConfig prop OR an ancestor provide(BLOB_CONFIG_KEY, ...). A mount with NEITHER throws. Demo consumer (demo/stories/goo-blob.vue) updated to pass :config=BLOB_CONFIG_DEFAULTS explicitly (one-line consumer change).
sites.surface: throw on absent config DI + no prop
sites.rationale: Reconciled with the resolver seam that already throws loudly; no silent stand-in for a required dependency.

sites.before: conflicting second initialValue seed silently ignored in prod (dev-warn only)
sites.disposition: A CONFLICTING second seed now THROWS (the createGlobalState singleton constraint is visible, not hidden). A MATCHING re-seed stays a no-op. JSDoc + module header updated to the throw contract.
sites.rationale: A misconfigured consumer learns at first conflict instead of shipping a wrong first-paint theme.

sites.before: deferred surfaceInitError re-throws on the microtask queue; two catches return silently; contract undocumented
sites.disposition: Behavior preserved (still re-throws when no onInitError). The CONTRACT is now loud: JSDoc states the three required consumer paths (onInitError | Vue errorHandler | accept the unhandled rejection); useAurora dev-warns ONCE when armed deferred with no handler; the two catches carry fail-explicit sentinels + the surfaced error path. WebGL2-unavailable still throws HARD (O-invariant 24 preserved).
sites.rationale: The deferred-tick failure is no longer silent-by-omission.

sites.before: 100+ lines of per-version tranche archaeology (39 tranche-letter refs in api/index.ts) in production re-export barrels
sites.disposition: Moved the audit trail (per-version surface-count tally + cherry-pick version history) to CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased section). Kept ONLY the live IN/NOT-in-scope scope criteria (api/index.ts) and the cherry-pick acceptance bar + exclusion criteria (index.ts). proof:no-legacy-commentary enforces zero tranche/version archaeology in either body.
sites.rationale: Live criteria are load-bearing doc; the version history is archaeology.

sites.before: mediumOil() has an `else if (mode == 2) return mediumOil_crayon(...)` special-case branch
sites.disposition: Excised the mode == 2 branch from mediumOil(); renamed mediumOil_crayon -> mediumCrayon (a peer, not an oil sub-mode); dispatched at main() level as uMedium == 4 alongside pastel/watercolor/oil. mediumOil() keeps only its genuine oil-stroke modes (0 oil, 1 knife, 3 chunky).
sites.shaderEquivalence: PIXEL-EQUIVALENT. The crayon path (mediumCrayon) reads no uStrokeMode uniform; its arguments (col, pN, t) are identical pre/post. The runtime resolves a medium:'oil'+strokeMode:'crayon' config to the crayon peer (resolveMediumId) and uploads a benign uStrokeMode (oil=0), which the crayon function never reads. Confirmed: grep shows no `mode == 2` and no uStrokeMode read inside mediumCrayon. proof:blob-color-equivalence 8/8, derive-aurora 13/13, proof:aurora-space-gamma + proof:shader-shared-source green.
sites.rationale: Crayon is wax-on-tooth, not oil strokes; it belongs at the medium-dispatch level, not as a guarded branch inside an oil function.

sites.before: four string-keyed Record<…, number> maps (MEDIUM_ID, FLOW_ID, WARP_ID, STROKE_MODE_ID)
sites.disposition: Replaced with sealed `as const satisfies Record<Union, number>` typed dispatch — a new union member is a COMPILE error until it gets a slot (no stale-Record gap). MEDIUM_ID gains the crayon: 4 peer slot; STROKE_MODE_ID drops crayon (Exclude<StrokeMode, 'crayon'>). resolveMediumId / resolveStrokeModeId thread the crayon peer derivation.
sites.rationale: Bidirectional type safety at the enum<->shader-int boundary; one source of truth.

sites.before: vt.ready?.catch(() => {}) — swallows the 'Transition was skipped' rejection
sites.disposition: KEPT (no code-path change). Annotated with the fail-explicit befitting sentinel: 'ready' rejects 'Transition was skipped' on a rapid re-trigger; the swallow prevents an unhandled pageerror; 'ready' is otherwise unread, so there is no real failure to surface.
sites.rationale: A documented progressive-enhancement swallow that prevents a real pageerror leak; befitting.
